name: codex-mcp
description: CodeLocal Go backend/CLI runtime with a Next.js web product.

scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:web
scripts.ci:web: npm ci --prefix web && npm run check --prefix web && npm audit --omit=dev --prefix web
scripts.ci: npm run check:repo && npm run ci:go && npm run ci:web
scripts.release:npm:prepare: npm run check:repo && npm run ci:go && npm run test:launcher && go run ./cmd/release && npm pack --dry-run ./.release/npm
scripts.release:prepare: npm run ci && npm run test:launcher && go run ./cmd/release && npm pack --dry-run ./.release/npm
scripts.release:npm: (npm whoami --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/ >/dev/null 2>&1 || npm login --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/) && npm whoami --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org/ && bash ./scripts/release-npm.sh
